purpose: Carry the long-arc plan into chapter-level generation objectives.

objectives.mandate: Hook the reader, stabilize the premise, and establish a clear conflict trajectory.
objectives.objective: Each chapter must create or sharpen reader commitment.

objectives.mandate: Expand conflict and differentiate relationships without losing forward motion.
objectives.objective: Each chapter must add a new pressure vector or relationship consequence.

objectives.mandate: Deliver the first major payoff and prove the larger track can sustain.
objectives.objective: Each chapter must move toward a visible payoff or consequence.

objectives.mandate: Raise the stakes and prevent plateau.
objectives.objective: Each chapter must introduce a new pressure source or cost.

objectives.mandate: Force a choice and prepare a map change.
objectives.objective: Each chapter must deepen urgency and point toward a new objective.

objectives.mandate: Open the next layer of conflict.
objectives.objective: Each chapter must reveal a new constraint, enemy, or complication.

objectives.mandate: Pay down the larger promise and strengthen trust.
objectives.objective: Each chapter must visibly advance the larger promise.

objectives.mandate: Deepen emotional investment and strategic stakes.
objectives.objective: Each chapter must create a meaningful emotional or strategic consequence.

objectives.mandate: Prepare the next climax and consolidate gains.
objectives.objective: Each chapter must clear a runway toward climax.

objectives.mandate: Deliver climax and set up the next long arc.
objectives.objective: Each chapter must either resolve or set up the transition hook.

next_actions: write chapter-band mandates into the generation chain
audit repeated chapter functions against the objectives
keep the plan revisable as the arc evolves
